findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_base_token_safety, should_i_pay · Private data: check_base_token_safety, should_i_pay · Public sink: check_base_token_safety.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_base_token_safety, should_i_pay · Private data: check_base_token_safety, should_i_pay · Public sink: check_base_token_safety

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
